name: SmrithiSangam — AI Cognitive Companion for Elderly Dementia Care
description: Cross-platform cognitive therapy and monitoring app for elderly dementia care in India's North Eastern Region (SIH26003, MDoNER). Features offline-first local storage, voice-guided games in Assamese, Manipuri, Khasi, and Mizo, rule-based adaptive difficulty, and caregiver/ASHA decline tracking.
